g.text: FastAPI entrypoint + LangGraph router -> the engines/ layer -> the core/ support layer
TRUST BOUNDARY — unauthenticated HTTP surface (auth.py:89-97 never 401s; main.py:55-56)
orchestrator — one uvicorn worker, one event loop (orchestrator/Dockerfile:52)

engines/ — 14 modules drawn as 13 components (vision.py and document.py both report route 'vision'). No ABC and no Protocol: the contract is a duck-typed `Emit = Callable[[str, dict], Awaitable[None]]` re-declared three times (chat.py:22, agent.py:34, graph.py:13)
core/ — GUARDS: the only application-layer barriers (blocklist-based; each is one bypass deep)
Dashed red rectangle = trust boundary (no authentication crossing it).
Red arrow = unauthenticated or externally-reachable hop.
Dotted purple rectangle = Python package grouping, not a process boundary.
Every arrow label is "what · protocol · sync|async · file:LINE".
Amber notes = retry / timeout / unbounded resource / swallowed exception,
each anchored to a file:LINE that was read.
"BLOCKING ... on the loop" = a synchronous call made inside an `async def`;
this process runs ONE uvicorn worker with ONE event loop
(orchestrator/Dockerfile:52), so each one stalls every concurrent SSE stream.
